india: India buys most of its oil from abroad, and a lot of it comes through the Gulf. Millions of Indians live and work in Gulf countries. When West Asia burns, India feels it at the petrol pump and at home.
lede: Israelis and Palestinians have fought over the same land since Israel was created in 1948. Gaza is a small Palestinian territory that was run by Hamas, an armed group. Iran, Israel's biggest rival in the region, backs Hamas and other groups. Here's how the latest chapter unfolded.

players.name: Israel
players.role: PM Benjamin Netanyahu. Wants Hamas gone from Gaza.

players.name: Hamas
players.role: Armed Palestinian group that ran Gaza. Led the 7 Oct 2023 attack.

players.name: Iran
players.role: Backs Hamas, Hezbollah and the Houthis. Israel's main rival.

players.name: USA
players.role: Israel's closest ally. Brokered the Gaza ceasefire.

players.name: Hezbollah
players.role: Armed group in Lebanon, backed by Iran.

players.name: Houthis
players.role: Armed group in Yemen. Attacks ships and Israel.

timeline.what: Hamas attacks southern Israel: about 1,200 killed, 251 taken hostage. Israel declares war on Hamas and invades Gaza.
Hezbollah fires rockets from Lebanon; the Houthis attack ships in the Red Sea. Israel kills top Hamas and Hezbollah leaders.
A ceasefire frees some hostages, then collapses in March.
A US-backed Gaza ceasefire starts on 10 Oct. The remaining living hostages come home.
The US and Israel strike Iran over its nuclear programme. Supreme Leader Khamenei is killed. Iran hits back at Israel, US bases and Gulf states; shipping through Hormuz freezes.
A US–Iran ceasefire comes in June, then breaks down in July. The US blockades Iran's ports.
US–Iran talks are stalled and attacks on ships near Hormuz have surged. Tankers with Indian crews were hit on 9, 11 and 16 Oct, and a UN plan to let fertiliser ships through is stuck.
Houthi strikes hit Saudi airports. Indian airlines pause Saudi flights; about 3,000 Indians, including Umrah pilgrims, are stranded.
Iran warns of an 'apocalyptic war' that would 'decide the fate' of Gulf nations if the US strikes again.
Houthis fire dozens of missiles at southern Saudi Arabia, targeting Riyadh airport hours after it reopened; most flights cancelled. Iran says war won't change its positions.

title: West Asia from zero
